προσέκλινε: προσκλίνω — lean (something) against; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented after the preverb

σανίδεσσιν: σανίς — board, door-leaf; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic σανίσιν)
στέατος: στέαρ — fat, tallow; neut. gen. sg.
σφε: σφε — them; epic enclitic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτούς), masc.

τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τανυστύος: τανυστύς — stringing, bending (of a bow); fem. gen. sg.

τανύω: τανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. 1 sg. act.

φθεγξάμενός: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, speak; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’having spoken’

ἀνέλκων: ἀνέλκω — draw up, draw back; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawing back’
ἀνένευε: ἀνανεύω — throw back the head, nod ’no’, refuse by a sign; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-νευε)

ἀποτρωπᾶσθε: ἀποτρωπάομαι — turn away from, shrink from (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., contracted: ’do not shrink’

ἀτασθαλίαι: ἀτασθαλία — reckless folly, wicked arrogance; fem. nom. pl.
ἀτρίπτους: ἄτριπτος — unworn, not rubbed by toil; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl.
ἀχαιΐδα: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean; adj. of land, fem. acc. sg.
ἁμαρτεῖν: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, fail of, be wanting; aor. inf. act.: ’to miss’
ἁπαλάς: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; fem. acc. pl.
ἄγρει: ἄγρει — come now! up!; epic interjection with an imper. sense (perhaps from ἀγρέω ’take’)
ἄφρονα: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. acc. sg.

ἐντάνυσε: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐνετάνυσε)
ἐντανύειν: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. inf. act.: ’to string’
ἐντανύσω: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short vowel (or fut. indic.)

ἐπεῖχε: ἐπέχω — hold back, hold off, restrain oneself; impf. 3 sg. act.

ἐρύσσεσθαι: ἐρύω — draw, pull; pres. inf. mid., epic doubled σ (= ἐρύεσθαι): ’to draw’
ἐχθραὶ: ἐχθρός — hateful, hostile; fem. nom. pl.

ἔναξε: νάσσω — pack down, stamp firm; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ἔ-ναξε)
ἕψεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, go with; fut. inf. mid.: ’to follow’

ὀρύξας: ὀρύσσω — dig; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having dug’
ὁμαρτήσαντες: ὁμαρτέω — go together with, accompany; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’going together’
ὁμιλέομεν: ὁμιλέω — keep company, be together, throng; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted -έομεν (= Attic ὁμιλοῦμεν)
ὄρνυσθ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rouse oneself, rise; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (ὄρνυσθ’ = ὄρνυσθε): ’rise!’
ὠκύ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. acc. sg.
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. acc. sg.

__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun of a thing, unemphatic ’it’ (masc. χιτών), as direct object of a verb: ἐθηήσαντο αὐτὸν ’gazed at it’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, direct object of a verb: θεὸς αὐτὸν ἐνείκαι ’a god might bring him’
__broaden__.βίης: βίη — might, force; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation with σχέσθαι ’hold back from force’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of μνησαμένοις: ’of the might’ (Κύκλωπός τε βίης ’the Cyclops’ might’) · also periphrastic gen. with a proper adj.: ’the force of Iphicles’ (βίης Ἰφικληείης, a periphrasis for his name) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of respect after ἔμπαιος ‘skilled’: ‘in strength’ (ἔμπαιον … βίης ‘skilled in strength’) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of want after ἐπιδευέες: ’lacking in strength’ (βίης ἐπιδευέες)
__broaden__.θέτ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (θέτ’ = θέτο), in tmesis (περὶ … θέτ’ = περιέθετο): ’set about’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό (ἀπὸ … θέτ’ = ἀπέθετο): ’laid aside’
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’)
__broaden__.οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with an implied dat. of the speaker: ’alone’ · also agreeing with a named dative: ’to Tiresias alone’ (Τειρεσίῃ … οἴῳ), ’he alone’ (τῷ … οἴῳ) · also agreeing with τοι ’you’: ’you alone’ (τοι οἴῳ) · also agreeing with the encl. dat. οἱ: ’to him alone’ (οἱ οἴῳ)
__broaden__.οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial and consecutive: ’so that, such that’ (οἷόν σ’ … οὐδέ σε πείθω) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, + τε: ’such as, like’ (οἷόν τε κρομύοιο λοπὸν κάτα ’such as is along the skin of an onion’) · also masc. acc. sg., οἷόν τε + inf.: ’such as to, fit to’ (οἷόν τε … ἔμεναι ’such as to be’)
__broaden__.πειρήσεται: πειράω — try, test, make trial of; fut. mid. 3 sg. · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., short vowel (= πειρήσηται), after ἐπήν without κε: ’whenever he tries’, + gen.
__broaden__.τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put!’ (πὰρ … τίθει ’set beside!’)
__broaden__.τανύσσαι: τανύω — stretch; aor. inf., epic σσ, used for an imperative: ’stretch!’ · also aor. inf. dependent on δύνασαι: ’to string’ (οὐ δύνασαι τανύσσαι ’you cannot string’)
__broaden__.χώρου: χῶρος — place, spot, land; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἄιδρις: ’of the place’ · also gen. of the starting point with ἀρξάμενοι: ’from the place’ (ἀρξάμενοι τοῦ χώρου)
__broaden__.ἀνέγνω: ἀναγιγνώσκω — know for certain, recognise; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-γνω), gnomic · also an ordinary narrative aor., not gnomic: ’recognised’ (νόον … ἀνέγνω ’recognised the mind’)
__broaden__.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’ · also ἄρ before an elided κ’ (κε), ’then’, in a question: ἦ ἄρ κ’ ἐθέλοις ’would you then be willing?’ · also the shortened ἄρ before a consonant, without elision: ’then’ (ἐπεὶ ἄρ βλέφαρ’ … ἀμφικαλύψῃ ’when then (sleep) has covered the eyelids’) · also ἄρ before ἕζετ’ without elision: ’then’ (κατ’ ἄρ ἕζετ’ ’then sat down’)
__broaden__.ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι) · also causal + indic.: ’since, because’ (ὅτ’ οὐκ ἐθέλουσι δικαίως ’since they are not willing to act justly’) · also + opt., of a time conceived as possible: ’when’ (ὅτ’ … λιποίμην ’when I should be left behind’)
__broaden__.ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’ · also possessive ὅς with the demonstrative -δε as in ὅδε, ’this his own’; the sense ’to’ lies in δόμονδε, not in ὅνδε
__broaden__.ῥυτῆρα: ῥυτήρ — protector, guardian (from ῥύομαι); masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’as protector’ · also, if from ἐρύω ’draw’: ’drawer, one who draws’ (ῥυτῆρα βιοῦ ’drawer of the bow’); the sense is disputed
